cities.name: Cogspire
cities.description: A neutral city of brass towers and ticking bridges. Every faith trades here.

cities.name: Santa Lucerna
cities.description: A walled city of bells and white stone, crowned by the Cathedral of the Lamp.

cities.name: Porticus
cities.description: Colonnades and libraries on a cold sea. The scholars here argue in whispers.

cities.name: Elderholt
cities.description: A town grown rather than built, among standing stones and oaks older than kings.

cities.name: Vinemere
cities.description: Lanterns, wine and masks. Every night is a feast, and every feast has a price.

cities.name: Ashenmouth
cities.description: A smoke-black town on the edge of the Pit. Its truce is old, and thin.

m_tech_1.title: Proof of Skill
m_tech_1.text: The guild only trades with duelists who can hold their own. Win two duels anywhere.

m_tech_2.title: Letter to the Cathedral
m_tech_2.text: Carry the guild's accounts north to Santa Lucerna.

m_church_1.title: Shadows on the Pilgrim Road
m_church_1.text: Covenant cultists prey on pilgrims. Defeat three of them.

m_church_2.title: The Nameless Lich
m_church_2.text: A lich has made a crypt of a ruined abbey in the south. Cleanse it.

m_church_3.title: Medicine for the Hospice
m_church_3.text: The grove-keepers of Elderholt grow herbs we need. Visit them.

m_stoa_1.title: Field Study
m_stoa_1.text: Observe the excesses of Vinemere, and return unchanged.

m_stoa_2.title: The Silent Sage
m_stoa_2.text: Our old master has stopped speaking and started duelling. Bring him back to reason.

m_grove_1.title: Iron in the Roots
m_grove_1.text: Constructs are cutting the old woods. Stop three of them.

m_grove_2.title: The Antlered One
m_grove_2.text: The great beast has gone mad. Prove yourself against it.

m_revel_1.title: Spoil the Sermon
m_revel_1.text: The Church's preachers are bad for business. Win three duels against them.

m_revel_2.title: The Endless Banquet
m_revel_2.text: Duke Carnevale's feast has lasted a year. Somebody must win the final toast.

m_abyss_1.title: Collect a Debt
m_abyss_1.text: Some scholars owe the Covenant. Defeat three of them.
